items.title: Sources: Jackson won't have deal with Ravens before start of season
items.description: Lamar Jackson has been reluctant to discuss a long-term extension with the Ravens and has been more focused on the upcoming 2026 season, league sources told ESPN.

items.title: Parker Washington: Unlikely to sign extension soon
items.description:
Washington is unlikely to agree to a contract extension with Jacksonville before the start of the season, Cameron Wolfe of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Source: Jags, WR Washington unlikely to agree to deal before season
items.description: The Jaguars and Parker Washington are unlikely to agree to a contract extension before the start of the season, a source told NFL Network.

items.title: Lamar Jackson: Contract extension talks on hold
items.description:
Jackson and the Ravens aren't expected to agree on a contract extension before 2027, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sources: Stroud, Texans to table extension talks amid looming QB market
items.description: The Texans and C.J. Stroud made a run at completing a contract extension before the regular season begins, but both sides agreed they now prefer to wait until after this season to work out a long-term deal, sources told ESPN and NFL Network

items.title: C.J. Stroud: Extension talks paused
items.description:
Stroud and the Texans will wait until after the 2026 season to work out a long-term contract extension, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Chiefs set to use undrafted rookie at LT as Simmons ruled out
items.description: Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons is out for Monday's season opener against the Broncos, with Kansas City expected to turn to undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson to help protect returning quarterback Patrick Mahomes.

items.title: Cooper Rush: Will start Week 1 despite back spasms
items.description:
Rush (back) experienced back spasms Saturday but still will start Sunday's game at Pittsburgh, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Sources: Packers, TE Kraft reach 4-year extension worth up to $92M
items.description: The Packers and tight end Tucker Kraft have reached agreement on a four-year extension worth up to $92 million, sources told ESPN.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Fades injury tag Week 1
items.description:
Mahomes (knee) does not have an injury designation for Monday's game against the Broncos.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Rush still to start for ailing Falcons despite back spasms
items.description: Falcons quarterback Cooper Rush experienced back spasms Saturday, but he will still start Sunday against the Pittsburgh Steelers, the team announced.

items.title: Sources: Raiders TE Mayer lands $45M extension as Bowers sidelined
items.description: Tight end Michael Mayer, who is stepping in for an injured Brock Bowers to start the regular season, has received a multiyear extension from the Raiders.
